text: いろんなこと　おしえて　あげてね

structure.jp: おしえて　あげてね

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus あげる says you do it as a favor for someone. おしえて　あげて = 'teach him, for his sake'.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: Ending on a bare て form is a casual request, with ください left off; ね softens it. あげてね = 'please do it for him, okay?'.
